title: Capture With Check
setup: Your rooks own the seventh rank, and a black pawn on b6 shares the sixth rank with the king on e6.
hint: There is a capture that opens a line and gives check in one move. Ask what stands beyond the king on that line.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rxb6+}} takes a pawn and, far more importantly, arrives on the sixth rank with check. The rook on **f6** is now behind its own king. {{Kd5}} is the only legal reply, and {{Rxf6}} wins the rook.
